overview.zh: 加密与AI基础设施同日推进：Solana升级、Meta开放权重模型与MSCI剔除规则重塑行业边界。 Solana升级：Solana将于10月21日激活Alpenglow，最终确认时间目标从约12.8秒降至约150毫秒，旧共识机制退役。 AI：欢迎 Muse Spark Open：Meta 推出的开放权重前沿多模态混合专家模型 指数规则：MSCI通过新规剔除非经营型公司，Strategy与Metaplanet在模拟中面临剔除风险，最终名单11月11日公布。
overview.en: Crypto and AI infrastructure advance in parallel as Solana upgrade, Meta open-weight model and MSCI exclusion rules redraw industry boundaries. Solana upgrade：Solana will activate Alpenglow on Oct. 21, targeting finality of about 150 milliseconds from roughly 12.8 seconds, retiring its old consensus. AI open weights：Meta released Muse Spark Open, calling it the most capable US open-weight model to date, runnable locally on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios. Index rules：MSCI adopted rules to exclude non-operating companies, with Strategy and Metaplanet flagged as potential removals; the final list is due Nov. 11.

title.zh: 晨间简报：Solana 即将变得更快
title.en: Morning Minute: Solana Is About To Get Faster

summary.zh:
Solana 已将 Alpenglow 的主网激活时间安排在 10 月 21 日约 15:00 UTC，届时将退役其自上线以来一直运行的共识机制。主导该升级的核心开发团队 Anza 表示，最终确认时间将从约 12.8 秒降至约 150 毫秒的目标水平，约快 85 倍。

最终确认（finality）即交易不再可被回滚的时刻，此前每一家交易所和支付处理商都不得不围绕约 13 秒的窗口进行设计，而此次升级意在关闭这一窗口。新机制被描述为可承受 20% 的质押恶意作恶外加 20% 离线，而旧系统在超过约三分之一质押 SOL 转为恶意时就会失效。

由于验证者将直接相互投票，而不再把投票作为链上交易提交，Solana 的头条交易数和 TPS 数据预计将大幅下降，尽管用户、交易量和应用都没有变化。该升级是两阶段中的第一阶段，第二阶段尚无日期；此前公布的 9 月 28 日激活日期曾被宣布后又推迟。
summary.en:
Solana has scheduled the mainnet activation of Alpenglow for October 21 at around 15:00 UTC, retiring the consensus mechanism it has run on since launch. Anza, the core development shop behind the upgrade, says finality will drop from roughly 12.8 seconds to a target of about 150 milliseconds — about 85 times faster.

Finality — the moment a transaction stops being reversible — has forced every exchange and payment processor to build around a roughly 13-second window, and the upgrade is intended to close it. The new mechanism is described as designed to survive 20% of stake acting maliciously plus another 20% simply offline, whereas the old system breaks if more than about a third of staked SOL turns hostile.

Because validators will vote directly to each other instead of casting votes as on-chain transactions, Solana's headline transaction count and TPS figures are expected to fall sharply even though users, volume and apps are unchanged. The upgrade is phase one of two, with no date yet for the second phase, and a previously announced September 28 activation date was announced and then pushed.

title.zh: 欢迎 Muse Spark Open：Meta 推出的开放权重前沿多模态混合专家模型
title.en: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta

summary.zh:
Meta 发布了 Muse Spark Open，这是一个开放权重的前沿多模态混合专家模型，Meta 称其为“迄今为止美国最强的开放权重模型”。Meta 表示，这是同类模型中首个可在桌面端运行的产品，需使用两台 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studio 和最新的 MLX 框架；Hugging Face 上的模型页面将其列为 Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B。

由于权重公开发布，前沿级多模态参数可以被下载、微调和自行部署，而不再只能通过 Meta 的服务访问。Meta 同时把 Apple 芯片定位为目标部署平台，主张这一级别的模型已可在本地桌面端运行。

Meta 与 Apple 为此次发布进行了合作，模型针对在 Apple 芯片上本地运行做了优化；社区引用的 Meta 部署文档显示其支持多种模型运行器，包括 Unsloth 和 MLX。已公布的模型标识为 Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B。
summary.en:
Meta announced Muse Spark Open, an open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model that it describes as "the most capable US open-weight model to date." Meta says it is the first model in its class that can run on a desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios with the latest MLX framework, and the Hugging Face listing names it Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B.

Because the weights are published, frontier-class multimodal parameters can be downloaded, fine-tuned and self-hosted rather than accessed only through Meta's services. Meta also frames Apple silicon as a target deployment platform, presenting local desktop inference as viable for a model of this class.

Meta and Apple teamed up for the launch, with the model optimized to run locally on Apple silicon; a community-linked Meta deployment page lists support across multiple model runners, including Unsloth and MLX. The published model identifier is Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B.

title.zh: MSCI 通过新的指数剔除规则；Strategy 与 Metaplanet 面临被剔除风险
title.en: MSCI Adopts New Index Exclusion Rules; Strategy and Metaplanet Face Potential Re

summary.zh:
MSCI 已通过新规则，将非经营型公司剔除出其全球可投资市场指数。在此前基于 2026 年 5 月数据的模拟中，MSCI 将比特币储备型公司 Strategy（MSTR）和 Metaplanet（3350）列为可能被剔除的对象，以太坊储备型公司 SharpLink（SBET）则被列入观察名单；最终受影响的成分股名单将于 11 月 11 日公布，新规则在 11 月 30 日收盘后生效。

一旦被剔除，追踪 MSCI 全球可投资市场指数的被动基金将被迫减持这些规模最大的上市比特币储备型股票，同时这也释放出对数字资产储备型公司收紧态度的信号。

被剔除需同时满足两个条件：未通过经营资产测试，且触发五项财务剔除标准中的至少四项；现有成分股必须在最近两个年度申报期均未通过筛选，才会被剔除。MSCI 还将解除此前对被认定数字资产占总资产至少 50% 的公司所施加的临时指数限制，改为按新方法进行评估。
summary.en:
MSCI has adopted new rules to exclude non-operating companies from its Global Investable Market Indexes. In an earlier simulation based on May 2026 data, MSCI identified Bitcoin treasury companies Strategy (MSTR) and Metaplanet (3350) as potential removals, while Ethereum treasury company SharpLink (SBET) would be placed on a watchlist; the final list of affected constituents is due November 11, with the rules effective after the November 30 close.

Index exclusion would force passive funds tracking MSCI's Global Investable Market Indexes to divest the largest listed bitcoin-treasury equities, and it signals a tightening stance toward digital-asset treasury vehicles.

Exclusion requires a company to fail an operating-assets test and trigger at least four of five financial exclusion criteria, and existing constituents must fail the screening in both of their two most recent annual filing periods before removal. MSCI will also lift temporary index restrictions on companies previously identified as holding digital assets worth at least 50% of total assets, assessing them under the new methodology instead.

title.zh: CoreWeave扩大借款计划引发市场不安，高收益债券持续下跌
title.en: CoreWeave's expanded borrowing plans stir market unease as high-yield bonds keep falling

summary.zh:
ICE Data Services 数据显示，CoreWeave 五年期信用违约掉期（CDS）成本周四一度上涨 74.5 个基点，至 1194.5 个基点，创盘中历史新高，意味着掉期市场定价反映该公司未来五年内违约概率超过 60%。同日，CoreWeave 债券成为美国高收益债券市场跌幅最大的债券之一，此前该公司计划进一步扩大借款规模。

报道将这一走势归因于债券投资者对人工智能融资热潮的不安，这促使市场重新评估部分大型科技公司的信用风险，表现为信用违约保险价格飙升、市场波动加剧以及债券表现疲软。

报道称 CoreWeave 是较早进入人工智能云计算领域的企业，并高度依赖高收益债券市场为其业务扩张融资，因此格外受到投资者关注。CDS 与债券数据来自 ICE Data Services。
summary.en:
ICE Data Services data showed CoreWeave's five-year credit default swap cost rose by as much as 74.5 basis points to 1194.5 basis points on Thursday, a record intraday high that implies the swap market is pricing more than a 60% probability of default within five years. CoreWeave bonds were among the biggest decliners in the US high-yield market the same day, as the AI cloud company plans to expand its borrowing further.

The report attributes the move to unease among bond investors over the AI financing boom, prompting a reassessment of credit risk at some large technology companies, reflected in surging credit-default insurance prices, heightened market volatility and weak bond performance.

CoreWeave is described as an early entrant to AI cloud computing that relies heavily on the high-yield bond market to finance its business expansion, making it a particular focus of investor attention. The CDS and bond data come from ICE Data Services.

title.zh: 诈骗者在被篡改的Ledger设备上损失480万美元：Asia Express
title.en: Scammer loses $4.8M stored on tampered Ledgers: Asia Express

summary.zh:
Ledger本周暂停了其在东南亚的经销商网络销售，此前窃贼通过供应链中被植入篡改的Ledger设备，从530个地址盗走超过1.034亿美元。Chainalysis报告称，其中一名受影响持有人本身就是从事“任务诈骗”的诈骗者，他购买的三台新Ledger内置记录助记词的间谍软件，导致其损失60枚比特币（约合480万美元）。

Ledger已要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚和香港的经销商下架其产品，这意味着在调查期间这些市场的买家将失去本地经销商渠道。Trezor也决定自1月1日起关闭部分偏远地区的经销商，称无法保证对这些渠道施加与本土市场同等水平的审查。

Ledger坚称迄今为止所有已确认的盗窃事件都发生在亚洲，尽管欧洲出现被篡改Ledger的报道促使电子产品零售商MediaMarkt暂停销售。该周报还提到，韩国金融情报分析院（FIU）批准屏蔽27家未注册交易所及其他虚拟资产服务商的网站，包括KuCoin、MEXC、Phemex和Bitrue；泰国证券交易委员会则敲定了允许比特币和以太坊ETF于周五开始交易的规则。
summary.en:
Ledger suspended its reseller network across South East Asia after thieves stole more than $103.4 million from 530 addresses using tampered Ledger devices inserted into the supply chain. Chainalysis reported that one of the affected holders was itself a task scammer who lost 60 Bitcoin (about $4.8 million) after buying three new Ledgers containing spyware that records seed phrases.

Ledger has asked resellers in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to remove its devices from sale, meaning buyers in those markets lose the local reseller channel while the tampering is investigated. Trezor also decided to shut some of its more far-flung resellers from Jan. 1, saying it cannot guarantee the same level of vigilance it applies closer to home.

Ledger insists that all confirmed thefts to date are from Asia, even though reports of tampered Ledgers in Europe prompted electronics retailer MediaMarkt to suspend sales. The roundup also notes that South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit approved measures to block domestic access to 27 websites of unregistered exchanges and other virtual asset service providers including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex and Bitrue, and that Thailand's SEC finalized rules allowing Bitcoin and Ether ETFs to begin trading Friday.

title.zh: 嘉信理财完成零售比特币与以太坊产品上线，并开始支持加密货币转账
title.en: Schwab Completes Retail Bitcoin and Ether Rollout, Begins Crypto Transfers

summary.zh:
据 The Defiant 报道，嘉信理财（Charles Schwab）已完成面向零售客户的比特币和以太坊交易功能上线，并开始允许客户将加密货币转入和转出其在嘉信的账户。

在买卖功能之外开放转账，改变了客户将数字资产放入大型美国零售券商账户后可以做的事。此次上线把现货加密货币的接入扩展至嘉信的零售客户群体。

此次上线面向零售客户，覆盖比特币和以太坊，加密货币转账被描述为该服务中最新开放的一环。
summary.en:
Charles Schwab has finished rolling out retail Bitcoin and Ether trading across its client base and has begun letting customers transfer crypto into and out of their Schwab accounts, according to The Defiant.

Adding transfers, not just buy-and-sell, changes what clients can do with digital assets once they are inside a large US retail brokerage account. The rollout extends spot crypto access to Schwab's retail client base.

The rollout covers Bitcoin and Ether for retail clients, with crypto transfers described as the newest part of the offering.

title.zh: 比特币剧烈震荡，加密货币清算规模逼近10亿美元
title.en: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion

summary.zh:
周四比特币一个多月来首次跌破8万美元，延续了周三由通胀数据引发的跌势。Decrypt援引CoinGlass的数据显示，24小时内共有177,440名交易者被清算，总额9.4822亿美元，其中多头仓位占8.5896亿美元，比例为90.6%。

此轮下跌使美国现货比特币ETF持有者重回浮亏状态：比特币现价较该群体约82,300美元的平均成本价低约2%，而自9月21日以来的24个交易日中，有21天收盘价高于该水平。Nexo分析师Iliya Kalchev称，能否收复这一位置是“任何反弹的第一道考验”。

以太坊以2.8203亿美元居清算规模首位，比特币略高于2亿美元；这是90天内多头清算第三重的一天，仅次于10月8日和8月22日。最大单笔清算为币安上一笔1,203万美元的比特币多单，在80,208.96美元被强制平仓；比特币最低触及79,711美元，随后被买盘拉回80,925美元附近，RSI约为44。
summary.en:
Bitcoin fell below $80,000 on Thursday for the first time in over a month, extending Wednesday's inflation-driven slide. CoinGlass data cited by Decrypt shows $948.22 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours across 177,440 traders, with long positions accounting for $858.96 million, or 90.6%.

The move put U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF holders back underwater: Bitcoin is trading roughly 2% below that cohort's average cost basis near $82,300, a level it had closed above on 21 of the 24 days since September 21. Nexo analyst Iliya Kalchev called reclaiming that line "the first test of any rebound."

Ethereum led liquidations at $282.03 million, with Bitcoin just over $200 million, and the day ranked third-heaviest for long liquidations in 90 days behind October 8 and August 22. The largest single order was a $12.03 million Bitcoin long on Binance force-closed at $80,208.96; Bitcoin hit a low of $79,711 before buyers pulled it back near $80,925, with the RSI around 44.

title.zh: 【万事达卡与 BVNK 推出法币及稳定币一体化平台】
title.en: Mastercard and BVNK launch integrated fiat and stablecoin platform

summary.zh:
万事达卡（Mastercard）与 BVNK 推出 Global Money Platform，通过单一 API 让银行、金融科技公司和企业嵌入同时承载法币与稳定币的多币种账户，并支持两者之间的实时兑换、稳定币关联卡以及通过 Mastercard Move 向本地银行账户付款。该平台目前已通过 BVNK 开放使用，是自 2026 年 8 月万事达卡完成对 BVNK 的收购以来，双方能力的首次重大整合。

该平台把稳定币余额直接接入万事达卡的卡组织与付款通道，而非置于其外，使银行、金融科技公司和企业可以通过单一接口完成两种形态资金的持有、兑换、转账与消费。Nuvei、Marqeta 以及 Ontop、Beem、Almond FinTech 属于首批接入方。

万事达卡表示，通过 Mastercard Move 进行的本地货币付款预计到 2027 年将覆盖 200 多个国家的 40 多种货币，发卡服务可在 130 多个国家提供。公司称该平台后续将增加对 agentic commerce（智能体商务）和代币化存款的支持。
summary.en:
Mastercard and BVNK launched the Global Money Platform, a single-API product that lets banks, fintechs and enterprises embed multi-currency accounts holding fiat and stablecoins, with real-time conversion between them, stablecoin-linked cards and local bank payouts via Mastercard Move. The platform is already available through BVNK and is the first major integration of the two companies' capabilities since Mastercard completed its acquisition of BVNK in August.

It puts stablecoin balances directly inside Mastercard's card and payout rails rather than beside them, giving banks, fintechs and enterprises a single connection for holding, converting, sending and spending both forms of money. Nuvei and Marqeta, alongside Ontop, Beem and Almond FinTech, are among the first to integrate.

Mastercard said coverage for local-currency payouts through Mastercard Move is expected to reach more than 40 currencies across over 200 countries in 2027, with card issuing available in more than 130 countries. The company said the platform will add support for agentic commerce and tokenized deposits down the line.

title.zh: Stripe 与 Plasma 将合作开发多币种稳定币卡
title.en: Stripe and Plasma to Develop Multi-Currency Stablecoin Cards

summary.zh:
Stripe 宣布与 Plasma 合作开发多币种稳定币卡，Plasma 将作为设计合作伙伴接入 Stripe 的稳定币发卡基础设施。该卡让个人和企业直接使用账户中已持有的币种余额消费，涵盖美元、巴西雷亚尔、欧元、墨西哥比索、哥伦比亚比索，以及 USDC、OUSD 和符合 GENIUS 法案要求的稳定币，目前覆盖 30 多个国家。

Stripe 表示，该方案旨在减少跨境支付中不必要的货币兑换和外汇成本，例如让持有欧元的用户直接以欧元消费，而无需先兑换成美元。

Stripe 还计划支持持卡人使用多个账户余额消费，并在购买时自动选择适当币种，企业也可以发行与自身支出需求相匹配的币种卡片。该服务目前覆盖 30 多个国家，计划于 2027 年扩展至 100 多个国家；具体交易规模和各市场上线时间未披露。
summary.en:
Stripe announced it is partnering with Plasma to develop multi-currency stablecoin cards, with Plasma acting as a design partner on Stripe's stablecoin card-issuing infrastructure. The cards let individuals and businesses spend directly from balances they already hold — including USD, BRL, EUR, MXN, COP, USDC, OUSD and stablecoins compliant with the GENIUS Act — and are available in more than 30 countries today.

Stripe says the arrangement is intended to cut unnecessary currency conversions and foreign-exchange costs for cross-border payments, for example letting a user who holds euros spend directly in euros instead of converting to USD first.

Stripe also plans to let cardholders spend from multiple account balances with automatic selection of the appropriate currency at the point of purchase, and businesses will be able to issue cards matching their own spending currencies. The service is expected to expand from more than 30 countries today to over 100 countries in 2027; no transaction volumes or per-market launch dates were disclosed.

title.zh: ⚡️Ripple Prime向机构客户推出RWA永续合约，覆盖100多个市场
title.en: ⚡️Ripple Prime launches RWA perpetual contracts for institutional clients, covering more than 100 markets

summary.zh:
据彭博社10月15日报道，Ripple旗下主经纪商部门Ripple Prime正面向机构客户推出现实世界资产（RWA）永续合约，覆盖股票、指数、ETF、大宗商品等100多个参考市场。该产品通过Hyperliquid上的Trade.xyz提供，并支持跨仓位共享保证金，延续了Ripple Prime此前向客户开放加密永续合约交易的布局。

Ripple Prime国际首席执行官Michael Higgins表示，此举有助于机构提高资金使用和仓位管理效率。客户既可将永续合约与标的资产配对开展基差交易，也可利用合约进行方向性交易，在传统市场休市期间及周末获取相关资产敞口。

Higgins还表示，传统对冲基金已「非常接近」直接参与代币化RWA市场，关键在于建立符合其交易对手及反洗钱要求的基础设施。据报道，过去一年，数个主要交易平台的RWA永续合约未平仓规模已从接近零增至90亿美元。
summary.en:
Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime is rolling out real-world asset (RWA) perpetual contracts to institutional clients, covering more than 100 reference markets including stocks, indices, ETFs and commodities, according to a Bloomberg report dated Oct. 15. The contracts are offered through Trade.xyz on Hyperliquid and support shared margin across positions, extending Ripple Prime's earlier opening of crypto perpetual trading to clients.

Ripple Prime International CEO Michael Higgins said the arrangement can help institutions improve capital efficiency and position management. Clients can pair the perpetual contracts with the underlying assets for basis trades or use them for directional exposure, including during traditional market closures and weekends.

Higgins also said traditional hedge funds are "very close" to directly participating in tokenized RWA markets, with the key being infrastructure that meets their counterparty and anti-money-laundering requirements. Over the past year, open interest in RWA perpetual contracts across major trading venues has grown from near zero to $9 billion, according to the report.

title.zh: 币安矿池即将关闭，其比特币矿工将何去何从？
title.en: Binance Pool is closing. Where will its Bitcoin miners go?

summary.zh:
币安矿池（Binance Pool）正在逐步关停其比特币矿池业务，相关报道指出关闭日期为11月10日，此前该矿池算力已下跌约65%。其矿工群体需要将矿机、收益结算设置与账户迁移至其他矿池。

此次关闭将迫使比特币算力在剩余矿池之间重新分配，这一变化直接影响挖矿集中度，并随着迁移矿工选择新运营方而影响各矿池的经济格局。

据 Mempool Brief 报道，关闭通知并未提及币安于2022年10月通过该矿池推出的5亿美元借贷计划。包括 EMCD 和 OCEAN 在内的替代矿池正在积极争取从币安矿池迁出的矿工。
summary.en:
Binance Pool is winding down its Bitcoin mining pool operation, with reports pointing to a shutdown on Nov. 10 after the pool's hashrate fell roughly 65%. Its miner base must now migrate hardware, payout settings and accounts to alternative pools.

The closure forces a redistribution of hash rate among the remaining Bitcoin mining pools, a shift that bears directly on mining concentration and on pool economics as displaced miners choose new operators.

The closure notice does not address the $500 million lending program Binance announced through the pool in October 2022, according to Mempool Brief. Alternative pools, including EMCD and OCEAN, are actively courting displaced Binance Pool miners.

title.zh: Anthropic 允许 METR 研究人员以员工级权限深入查看内部系统
title.en: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access

summary.zh:
Anthropic 已向 METR 研究人员开放员工级内部系统权限，使这家独立非营利机构能够自行开展风险与事件评估。Anthropic 同时同意，无权阻止 METR 发布相关评估结果。

METR 将自行发布对 Anthropic 风险、事件与做法的评估，而这家前沿实验室放弃了阻止发布的权力，这是第三方 AI 安全监督与问责机制上的一项结构性变化。

Anthropic 所表述的承诺是向第三方评估者提供永久性的员工级权限，以便其从公司内部检查安全机制与模型行为。METR（Model Evaluation and Threat Research，模型评估与威胁研究）是一家位于加州伯克利的非营利机构，负责评估前沿模型执行长周期智能体任务的能力。
summary.en:
Anthropic has given METR researchers employee-level access to its internal systems so the independent nonprofit can conduct its own risk and incident evaluations. Anthropic has also agreed that it cannot block METR from publishing those findings.

METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic's risks, incidents and practices, with the frontier lab surrendering the right to block publication — a structural change in third-party AI safety oversight and accountability.

Anthropic's stated commitment is to provide third-party evaluators with permanent, employee-level access, an arrangement meant to let them inspect safety protocols and model behavior from inside the company. METR — Model Evaluation and Threat Research — is a Berkeley, California-based nonprofit that evaluates frontier models' ability to carry out long-horizon, agentic tasks.

title.zh: 库克：苹果智能接入阿里千问大模型，10月底在中国发布测试版本
title.en: Cook: Apple Intelligence to Integrate Alibaba's Qwen Large Model, Test Version to Launch in China by End of October

summary.zh:
苹果 CEO 蒂姆·库克表示，苹果智能（Apple Intelligence）将接入阿里巴巴的千问（Qwen）大模型，并计划于10月底在中国发布测试版本。此次落地暂不包括 Siri AI。

这一安排决定了在中国大陆为苹果智能提供模型能力的合作方；据路透社报道，对阿里巴巴而言，与苹果内置软件的整合可能让千问的使用范围超出其自有应用与云服务。这也确认了苹果在该市场采用本土模型合作伙伴，而非自有模型。

该表述出自库克本人，指向的是测试版本而非正式全量商用，中国上线时间点定在10月底。Siri AI 被明确排除在这一阶段之外。
summary.en:
Apple CEO Tim Cook said Apple Intelligence will integrate Alibaba's Qwen large model, with a test version to be released in China by the end of October. Siri AI is not included in this rollout for now.

The arrangement determines which model powers Apple Intelligence on the Chinese mainland, and for Alibaba, integration with Apple's built-in software could broaden Qwen's reach beyond its own applications and cloud services, according to Reuters. It also confirms Apple's use of a domestic model partner rather than its own models in that market.

The statement came from Cook and concerns a test build, not a full commercial release, with the end-of-October timing given for China. Siri AI is explicitly excluded from this phase.

title.zh: Binance.US 寻求融资1亿美元以扩展其加密业务
title.en: Binance.US Seeks $100 Million to Expand Its Crypto Business

summary.zh:
据彭博社报道，Binance.US 正寻求在一轮私募融资中筹集至多1亿美元，目标估值约为10亿美元，用于扩展其美国业务。与特朗普家族有关联的加密项目 World Liberty Financial 已知悉此次融资，但并未参与。

这笔拟议中的融资将为这家美国关联公司提供新的资金以推进扩张，而此前在币安2023年与美国监管机构达成和解后，其市场份额已大幅下滑。该轮融资仍在寻求阶段，尚未完成，交易条款也未披露。

Binance.US 正在探索拓展预测市场业务，寻求恢复部分州的货币传输牌照，并考虑引入外部交易流动性来源，其中可能包括币安全球交易所，但目前尚未做出最终决定。
summary.en:
Bloomberg reported that Binance.US is seeking to raise up to $100 million in a private funding round at a target valuation of roughly $1 billion, in order to expand its US operations. World Liberty Financial, a crypto venture linked to the Trump family, was made aware of the fundraising but is not participating.

The reported round would give the US affiliate fresh capital to expand at a time when it has lost significant market share following Binance's 2023 settlement with US authorities. The raise is being sought, not completed, and no terms have been disclosed.

Binance.US is exploring expansion into prediction markets, seeking to restore certain state money transmitter licenses, and considering external sources of trading liquidity that could potentially include Binance's global exchange, though no final decision has been made.
